WITH m AS (SELECT c.d, c.jmonth, c.day_in_month, c.mdays, SUM(r.b2c + r.b2b) OVER (PARTITION BY c.jmonth ORDER BY c.d) cum FROM cal c JOIN revenue_daily r USING(d)) SELECT m.d, ROUND(100.0*m.cum/(t.target_million_toman*1e6*m.day_in_month/m.mdays),1) value FROM m JOIN monthly_targets t ON t.jmonth=m.jmonth AND t.scope='ORG'
